'''Ti'mere's InfoServices''' was a company owned by [[Byro Ti'mere]] that specialized in the gathering and sale of information. The company was based on the [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Brugga]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]]. To check the accuracy of their gathered info, the company employed a [[MicroThrust Processors]] [[SuperComp VII computer|SuperComp VII]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]].
